gen-fs-oswald-gf-akatab: Tall, tight, and sure of itself, Oswald packs its rows together with real force. Akatab follows in rounded sans letters that look cupped rather than clenched, so a heading made small would lose its punch while the body stays friendly.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-assistant: Confident and strong, Oswald sets rows of text tightly knit, like a crowd standing shoulder to shoulder. And Assistant keeps its mouths open on c, e, and a, so a longer passage in this plain sans moves along without feeling cramped.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-asta-sans: Oswald is the loud one here, a display face with tightly knit rows and a confident, strong stance. Asta Sans does the quieter job, with tubelike lines that hold their weight from stem to curve and an e you never mistake for a blot.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-bai-jamjuree: Bai Jamjuree reads light and unpinched in its round letters, with no thick-and-thin modulation at all. And Oswald stands above it, confident and tightly knit, giving the pair a strong top line over a gentle, approachable body.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-barlow: Oswald packs its rows tight and strong. Barlow answers underneath in sans-serif with c shapes whose tips pull well apart and neon-tube strokes, so enlarging its size a touch would suit that friendly, constant line.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-biz-udgothic: BIZ UDGothic reads modern and businesslike, with a wide channel leading into every bowl. And Oswald is the one built for force, its tightly knit rows making a confident statement while the sans-serif body does the patient work.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-biz-udpgothic: BIZ UDPGothic spreads out generously and invitingly. Oswald does what a display face does best, packing tight, confident rows with strength, while the sans below lets each round letter breathe through a clear channel.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-bpmf-huninn: Oswald hits hard, with tightly knit rows and a confident, strong build. Bpmf Huninn then carries a longer passage in a modern sans, its n arches as thick as the stems beside them and a wide channel into every bowl.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Tight, strong, and sure of itself, Oswald crowds its rows with confidence. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std brings a restrained swell to its curves and counters that stay connected to the outside, while the heading earns its keep when big and short.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-cairo: Oswald's tightly knit rows give it a confident, strong look. Its job is to hit hard in a display line, and Cairo's job is the opposite, opening a wide channel into every bowl so the sans-serif body stays modern and easy going.
